# ArduinoJson 7.4.3 (vendored for host tests)

Unmodified copy of `src/` and `LICENSE.txt` from ArduinoJson 7.4.3 (MIT, Benoit Blanchon,
https://arduinojson.org), the same version ESPHome's `json` component uses. Only used to compile
the firmware's layout parser on the host (`firmware/test/parser.cpp.test.ts`); firmware builds use
ESPHome's own copy.
